BEGIN_SOURCE
:- module(miter_mattermost_bridge, [
    surface_ingest/5,
    surface_effect/5,
    surface_reconnect/4,
    surface_panic/2
]).

:- use_module(library(dicts)).

%% Ingest: authorize before reading any event data.

surface_ingest(Config, State0, Frame, State, Outcome) :-
    is_dict(Frame),
    is_dict(Config),
    !,
    (   authorized(Config, Frame, SID, TID, CID, UID)
    ->  true
    ;   State = State0,
        Outcome = _{status:rejected, reason:unauthorized}, !
    ),
    get_dict(event, Frame, E),
    get_dict(data, Frame, D),
    (   event_payload(E, D, PID, RID, TS)
    ->  true
    ;   State = State0,
        Outcome = _{status:rejected, reason:invalid_event}, !
    ),
    get_dict(seq, Frame, Seq, 0),
    get_dict(auth_ref, Config, AuthRef, none),
    accept_event(SID, TID, CID, UID, E, PID, RID, TS, Seq, AuthRef,
                 State0, State, Outcome).

surface_ingest(_Config, State0, _Frame, State, Outcome) :-
    State = State0,
    Outcome = _{status:rejected, reason:invalid_frame}.

%% Authorization: all four identities must match before event access.

authorized(Config, Frame, SID, TID, CID, UID) :-
    get_dict(server_id, Config, CSID),
    get_dict(team_id, Config, CTID),
    get_dict(channel_id, Config, CCID),
    get_dict(user_id, Config, CUID),
    get_dict(server_id, Frame, SID),
    get_dict(team_id, Frame, TID),
    get_dict(channel_id, Frame, CID),
    get_dict(user_id, Frame, UID),
    SID == CSID,
    TID == CTID,
    CID == CCID,
    UID == CUID.

%% Supported events with stable post identifiers and version timestamps.

event_payload(posted, D, PID, RID, TS) :-
    get_dict(id, D, PID),
    get_dict(root_id, D, RID),
    get_dict(create_at, D, TS).

event_payload(post_edited, D, PID, RID, TS) :-
    get_dict(id, D, PID),
    get_dict(root_id, D, RID),
    get_dict(edit_at, D, TS).

%% Acceptance: monotone cursor, update-aware dedupe on event-version pairs.

accept_event(SID, TID, CID, UID, E, PID, RID, TS, Seq, AuthRef,
             State0, State, Outcome) :-
    get_dict(cursor, State0, Cursor),
    (   TS >= Cursor
    ->  true
    ;   State = State0,
        Outcome = _{status:suppressed, reason:stale_cursor}, !
    ),
    Pair = E-(PID-TS),
    get_dict(seen, State0, Seen),
    (   memberchk(Pair, Seen)
    ->  State = State0,
        Outcome = _{status:suppressed, reason:duplicate}, !
    ;   true
    ),
    NewCursor is max(Cursor, TS),
    State = State0.put(cursor, NewCursor).put(seen, [Pair|Seen]),
    Outcome = _{status:accepted,
                event:_{schema:miter_surface_event_v1,
                        server_id:SID,
                        team_id:TID,
                        channel_id:CID,
                        user_id:UID,
                        post_id:PID,
                        root_id:RID,
                        event_timestamp:TS,
                        cursor:Seq,
                        authorization_ref:AuthRef}}.

%% Effect: inert descriptor only; no network, no credentials.

surface_effect(_Config, State0, _Effect, State, Outcome) :-
    get_dict(panic, State0, true),
    !,
    State = State0,
    Outcome = _{status:rejected, reason:panic_active}.

surface_effect(Config, State0, Effect, State, Outcome) :-
    is_dict(Effect),
    get_dict(schema, Effect, miter_surface_effect_v1),
    get_dict(id, Effect, ID),
    get_dict(idempotency_key, Effect, IK),
    get_dict(channel_id, Effect, CID),
    get_dict(message, Effect, M),
    !,
    (   get_dict(channel_id, Config, CCID),
        CID == CCID
    ->  true
    ;   State = State0,
        Outcome = _{status:rejected, reason:unauthorized_channel}, !
    ),
    Pair = ID-IK,
    get_dict(effects, State0, Effects),
    (   memberchk(Pair, Effects)
    ->  State = State0,
        Outcome = _{status:suppressed, reason:duplicate_effect}, !
    ;   true
    ),
    State = State0.put(effects, [Pair|Effects]),
    Outcome = _{status:accepted,
                descriptor:_{method:post,
                             path:'/api/v4/posts',
                             body:_{channel_id:CID, message:M},
                             idempotency_key:IK}}.

surface_effect(_Config, State0, _Effect, State, Outcome
